intervention: Change only nominal profile lookup to original alpha.5 zero table. Original Actor and reward receive user alpha0 or1, unchanged.
alpha05: No treatment difference when Actor alpha=.5, so do not rerun or count it as a repeated independent condition.
stop: 40 new endpoint episodes (32 disturbed + 8 nominal); exact200 endpoint controls reused, analysis240. No profile fitting, gain/threshold sweep, training, automatic retry or adoption.
